name: jankolenko-skills
description: Composable, portable agent skills — read and update any Jira and Confluence Data Center instance, plus reusable atoms for finding a repo, planning a change, settling a decision that outlives it, branching, testing, debugging, checking the diff against the plan and the base branch, documenting, committing, opening a PR, resolving its review comments and recording what the run learned, wired together by implement — explain and draft-reply, which need no repo open at all — and a self-improving skill layer: a session-start rule that notices friction, improve-skill to fix a skill in whichever repo owns it, and find-skill-gaps to propose new skills from a cross-session evidence ledger. Nothing here is bound to one employer or programme; team-specific workflows live in the companion jankolenko-projects plugin.
